fields.exception_id: stable lowercase snake_case identifier without year/version
fields.skill_ids: array of stable Skill Graph skill_id values
fields.subskill_ids: array of stable Skill Graph subskill_id values
fields.exam_task_numbers: current task-number links; may be empty if exception is useful but not tied to one task
fields.exception_type: lexical_exception | morphological_exception | orthographic_exception | punctuation_exception | orthoepic_norm | homonym_confusion | lexicalized_case | other_verified_case
fields.wrong_forms: known useful distractors or common wrong variants, only when source/usage evidence supports them
fields.rule_ref: reference to explanation_id or stable rule identifier
fields.why_exception: compact explanation of why the general shortcut is unsafe or insufficient
fields.memory_cue: optional learner-facing mnemonic/contrast cue that must not contradict the rule
fields.contrast_with: array of exception_id or normal-case IDs commonly confused with this item

fields.source_path: repository-relative path or stable source identifier
